name: Shaphan
bio: Shaphan the scribe, son of Azaliah, was sent by King Josiah to the temple to oversee the funds collected for its repair. There, Hilkiah the high priest gave him the newly found book of the law, which Shaphan read himself before reading it aloud to Josiah. Josiah's reaction — tearing his clothes — led him to send Shaphan, along with Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, and Asahiah, to consult Huldah the prophetess about the book's warnings (2 Kings 22:3-14). His son Ahikam continued to serve as a royal official, told in detail in the chapters ahead.
